Stanbic IBTC Shari’ah Fixed Income Fund

Highlights
  • The Stanbic IBTC Shari'ah Fixed Income Fund (SISFIF) was launched in August 2019
  • The Fund invests a minimum of 70% of its portfolio in Sukuk and a maximum of 30% in shari’ah-compliant fixed term instruments
  • There is no minimum holding period
  • The minimum investment amount is N5,000.00 
  • It is an open ended fund
  • The risk profile is “Aggressive”
  • The management fee is 1.5% per annum
